chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Aban al-Ahmar, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:

Whoever becomes Muslim upon an inheritance before the inheritance is distributed, it is for him; and whoever becomes Muslim after it has been distributed, there is no inheritance for him; and whoever is emancipated upon an inheritance before the inheritances are distributed, it is for him; and whoever is emancipated after it has been distributed, there is no inheritance for him.
And he (peace be upon him) said regarding the woman: If she becomes Muslim before the inheritance is distributed, then for her is the inheritance.
ai.seo_question: Does a convert to Islam inherit from their non-Muslim family if they convert before the estate is distributed?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the timing of inheritance rights for converts or emancipated slaves, establishing that the estate division (qism) is the critical juncture for determining eligibility. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that the legal status at the moment of distribution, rather than the time of death, governs the right to inherit, ensuring fairness for those who change status during the probate period. The ruling explicitly extends to women, affirming their equal standing in this specific legal mechanism.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Aban Al Ahmar, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘The one who becomes a Muslim upon an inheritance before the distribution of the inheritance, so it is for him; but the one who becomes a Muslim after the distribution, so there is no inheritance for him; and the one who is emancipated (liberated) upon an inheritance before the distribution of the inheritance, so it is for him; and the one who is emancipated (liberated) after the distribution, so there is no inheritance for him’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said regarding the woman: ‘If she becomes a Muslim before the distribution of the inheritance, so for her is the inheritance’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Aban al-Ahmar from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said, ‘

If one becomes a Muslim before the legacy is distributed the legacy belongs to him. If one becomes a Muslim after the legacy is distributed there is no legacy for him. If one is set free before the legacy is distributed it belongs to him but if one is set free after the legacy is distributed then there is no legacy for him.’
About the case of a woman he (the Imam) said, ‘If she becomes a Muslim before the legacy is distributed she receives her share of the legacy.’”
